reasoning_steps: Identify the original square with side length 10 cm.
Note that the smaller square is formed by joining the midpoints of the sides of the original square.
Calculate the diagonal of the original square.
The diagonal of the original square is 10√2 cm.
Since the smaller square is formed by connecting the midpoints, its diagonal is half the diagonal of the original square.
Therefore, the diagonal of the smaller square is 5√2 cm.
Calculate the side length of the smaller square using the diagonal.
The side length of the smaller square is 5 cm.
